name: Tarnfield Flour Mills
description: Flour mill in the fictional town of Tarnfield.

items.title: Flour grades
items.content: Tarnfield mills 5 grades; strong bread flour has 13.2% protein. Spec sheet TFM-GRD-5.

items.title: Mill tours
items.content: Tours run on the third Saturday at 10:55 for groups of up to 16. Leaflet TFM-TOUR-16.

items.title: Dust explosion prevention
items.content: Hot work near silo 3 needs a permit from Eamon Doyle; dust is cleaned every 6 hours. Rules TFM-DUST-3.

items.title: Grain intake
items.content: Lorries are sampled at the weighbridge; moisture over 15.4% is rejected. Procedure TFM-INT-154.

items.title: Pallet supplier account
items.content: Pallets come from Woodstack Pallets at $9.70 each, 1,300 a month, under account TFM-PAL-970.

items.title: Mill closure study
items.content: Owners are studying closing Tarnfield by 2028 and moving milling to a site at Brayhurst; the study ends on 2027-01-29. Study TFM-CLS-0129-B.
